<!-- The interactive isogeny graph. Used on the home page and on the Animations pages
     through Quarto's include shortcode (see index.qmd), followed by a <script type="module"> tag loading assets/js/isogeny-hero.js (the path
     is relative to the page). To start in the growing-ball animation instead of the
     random walk, wrap the include in  ::: {data-mode="ball"}  ...  :::
     The data (assets/data/isogeny/) is made by _scripts/isogeny_graphs.py. -->

```{=html}
<figure class="wm-graph" id="wm-graph">
  <div class="wm-graph-controls">
    <div class="wm-seg" role="group" aria-label="Which isogeny graph to draw">
      <button type="button" data-kind="2" aria-pressed="true">ℓ = 2</button>
      <button type="button" data-kind="23" aria-pressed="false">ℓ = 2, 3</button>
      <button type="button" data-kind="2b3" aria-pressed="false">2 · level 3</button>
      <button type="button" data-kind="23b5" aria-pressed="false">2, 3 · level 5</button>
    </div>
    <div class="wm-graph-selects">
      <label class="wm-graph-view">view
        <select aria-label="Full graph, folded by Frobenius, or spine only">
          <option value="full" selected>full graph</option>
          <option value="folded">folded by Frobenius</option>
          <option value="spine">spine only</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="wm-graph-prime">p = <select aria-label="Characteristic p"></select></label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wm-graph-stage">
    <svg class="wm-graph-svg" role="img" aria-labelledby="wm-graph-caption"></svg>
    <div class="wm-graph-tip" hidden></div>
  </div>
  <div class="wm-graph-walk">
    <label class="wm-graph-walk-label">animation
      <select class="wm-graph-anim" aria-label="Which animation to run">
        <option value="walk" selected>random walk</option>
        <option value="ball">growing ball</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="wm-graph-history">history
      <select class="wm-graph-trail-len" aria-label="Number of recent steps to keep highlighted">
        <option value="10" selected>10 steps</option>
        <option value="25">25 steps</option>
        <option value="50">50 steps</option>
        <option value="100">100 steps</option>
        <option value="250">250 steps</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>speed
      <select class="wm-graph-speed" aria-label="Speed of the random walk">
        <option value="calm">calm</option>
        <option value="fast" selected>fast</option>
        <option value="frantic">frantic</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>
  <figcaption>
    <span class="wm-graph-caption" id="wm-graph-caption">Supersingular isogeny graphs: the objects I study.</span>
    <span class="wm-graph-ball-status" aria-live="polite" hidden></span>
    <span class="wm-graph-stats"></span>
    <span class="wm-graph-legend">
      <span><i class="wm-key wm-key-node"></i>supersingular curve</span>
      <span class="wm-graph-legend-pair" hidden><i class="wm-key wm-key-pair"></i>conjugate pair {E, E<sup>(p)</sup>}</span>
      <span class="wm-graph-legend-fp"><i class="wm-key wm-key-fp"></i><span>defined over F<sub>p</sub></span></span>
      <span><i class="wm-key wm-key-2"></i>2-isogeny</span>
      <span class="wm-graph-legend-3" hidden><i class="wm-key wm-key-3"></i>3-isogeny</span>
      <span class="wm-graph-legend-ball"><i class="wm-key wm-key-ball"></i>ball <i class="wm-key wm-key-hit"></i>shortest paths to the conjugate pair (red)</span>
      <span class="wm-graph-legend-walk"><i class="wm-key wm-key-walk"></i><i class="wm-key wm-key-trail"></i>random walk, last <span class="wm-trail-n">10</span> steps</span>
    </span>
    <span class="wm-graph-field"></span>
    <span class="wm-graph-hint">Hover or tap a vertex for its j-invariant; drag to rearrange. In the growing-ball animation, tap a vertex to grow a ball from it. <a href="/animations/">More animations →</a></span>
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```
